svg.title: Where sworn hooks into a session
svg.desc: Eight hook events, from the opening of the session to its end, each with the scripts that run there. SessionStart, abertura.js: your rules, the scope and five blocks come back. UserPromptSubmit, abrir-turno.js: an expensive return to an idle chat is stopped once, and a correction becomes a rule proposal. PreToolUse on Write and Edit, portao-escopo.js: scope, untouchables, another session's files, search first, ratchet, manual and design tokens. PreToolUse on Bash and PowerShell, portao-destrutivo.js, portao-estilo.js and portao-commit.js: destructive command, shell syntax, stray cd, style by shell and commit without review. PreToolUse on Task and Agent, portao-agente.js and portao-apelido.js: top-tier agent on light work, and the model nickname, which only warns. PreToolUse on AskUserQuestion, portao-decisao.js: exactly 3 options, the recommended one first. PostToolUse, SubagentStart and SubagentStop, marcar-trabalho.js, abrir-subagente.js and gravar-veredito.js: they count work, searches, decisions and commits, give the less-code block to subagents and save review verdicts. Stop, portao-fecho.js: proof, open sub-item, handoff prompt, review and reference, and when to switch chats. SessionEnd, fim-sessao.js: cleans session files idle for more than 7 days. A solid amber dot marks the moments that can deny or hand the turn back; a gray ring, the ones that only inject, count or clean.

g.font-family: 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
g.text: Where sworn hooks into a session
Eight hook events, from the opening to the end; PreToolUse has one row per tool
Opens, resumes or compacts: your rules, the scope and five blocks come back.

Destructive command, shell syntax, stray cd, style by shell, commit without review.
Top-tier agent on light work; the model nickname (warns only).
A question to you: exactly 3 options, the recommended one first.
Counts work, searches, decisions, commits; less code to subagents; saves verdicts.
End of the turn: proof, open sub-item, handoff prompt, review, reference; when to switch chats.
